notes.title: DEMO Update 2.0.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Captains! 👋[/b][/h1] 

[h2][b]Demo Update 2.0.0 is now available to download! ✅[/b][/h2]

First of all, we would like to thank all those who decided to leave their feedback, reviews and opinions regarding the demo version - it was incredibly important for us to know what needs to be improved and in which direction YOU 🫵 our players, want the game to develop - [b]thank you for that! 🤝[/b]

[b]Today, we are back with the first update to the demo version - 2.0.0 - which introduces many key changes, and most importantly, bug fixes that you reported to us after playing the demo version.[/b]

You can find the full list of changes below, we sincerely encourage you to check out the demo version and leave your opinion after the fixes. 🫡

Additionally, remember that we are also working on a free Prologue to the game, which you can add to your wishlist now and click the follow button 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3001790/Nuclear_Sub_Prologue/
[h3][b]Once again, thank you for every opinion and we encourage you to play the newest demo version! 🔥[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]📝 [u]List of changes[/u]:[/b][/h3]
- The game now saves progress. The player can load the game from the last checkpoint.
- The tutorial mission has been completely redesigned.
- Added shot prediction:
- When the player wants to shoot down a moving ship, they must enter tactical view.
- Enable the prediction panel.
- Set the time.
- During that time, they must perform the necessary actions to shoot down the ship.
- Added reactor dashboard:
- The player can control the reactor’s power level.
- The reactor can overheat.
- The player can perform an emergency shutdown.
- All other ship systems consume X% of reactor power.
- Manual steering dashboard:
- Visual update.
- The player can now manually steer the ship.
- Enemy ships are visible on radar, and mines are visible on the magnetic anomaly detector near the dashboard.
- Mines have been added – if the player hits one, they die.
- Radio has been added:
- The player can select a specific frequency.
- Can communicate with the base.
- Can eavesdrop on enemy ships.
- Subtitles are displayed during dialogues.
- The tracking mission has been modified. The player now sees the required range they must stay within.
- Values on dials can now be entered using the keyboard.
- Tactical view has been improved:
- In tactical view, the player can control the ship.
- The player can also accelerate time.
- Game options have been expanded.
- MANY BUG FIXES

Have fun!
Nuclear Sub Team

notes.title: Tactical View
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Captains! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back! It’s been a while since the last devlog because our main objective was to focus on and put into life as many key points from your feedback as possible. Today we’d like to showcase one of the very important mechanics during your gameplay -[b]tactical view[/b] 👀 and tell you about some of the changes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/e46659af5d2e038478aa76e11ff67e672d563552.png[/img]
[h3][b]What is the tactical view? 🤔[/b][/h3]
Tactical view is the most detailed view available for the player of what’s going on around your submarine. It’s pretty versatile as it can allow you to see how close, or how far from the ship you can be to successfully tail it. 🤫 It’s also invaluable during the conflicts because when ships are in motion, you can use it to estimate and set predictions to where you and your opponent will be. 📝 This maneuver allows you to collect enough data to gain the edge and shoot down the enemy vessel. 💪

What’s more, this view doesn’t restrict your movement options in any way and you can keep controlling the speed, maneuvers and other steering features like you’ve always had.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/d7af7601f6c4ee0aff153fcdd3254763e6945fcf.png[/img]
[h3][b]Improvements 📓[/b][/h3]
The demo release allowed us to understand much better what kind of game you’d like Nuclear Sub to become. That’s why we’ve put a lot of effort into improving various aspects of the game based on your feedback. 

The key features we’ve focused on thus far are as follows:
[list]-[b]Reactor control commands[/b]: from now on you won’t have to make trips to the reactor to control it,

-[b]Time limited tutorial mission changes[/b]: We remade the time-limited tutorial mission which was a frustrating experience for many players. Now the tutorial is more slow-paced and allows you to take your time to learn the ropes,

-[b]Improved tactical view[/b]: you can now see circles which indicate the minmax distance you can keep during the tracking mission,

-[b]Subtitles during the crucial dialogs[/b],

-[b]Improved shooting while units are moving[/b].[/list]
We hope that the addition of these fixes will make for a much more enjoyable experience. That’s it for today, there is some important news just around the corner so make sure to add the game to your wishlist and join our discord to be notified about them! 👇

See you soon!

notes.title: Reactor
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Captains! ⚓[/b][/h1]

Today, we're excited to share details about one of the most critical mechanics that defines our game - [b]reactor management[/b]. This system accompanies you throughout the entire gameplay, influencing every aspect of controlling your submarine. You'll soon realize that the reactor is not just a power source, but also a key element of strategy and survival in the depths.

[h3][b]🛠️ Reactor - How It Works?[/b][/h3]
The reactor is the central element of the gameplay, powering all systems of your submarine. From speed to sonar and torpedo systems, even controlling noise emissions - everything depends on the reactor's power.

[b]Main reactor parameters:[/b]

[list][b]Reactor Power[/b]: 0% to 100%
[b]Core Temperature[/b]: Low, Normal, High, Critical
[b]Noise Level[/b]: Silent, Normal, Loud[/list]
[h3][b]🎛️ Player Controls[/b][/h3]
As the captain, it's your job to manage the reactor and adjust its performance according to the situation at hand. Here's what you can control:

[list][b]Reactor Power Slider[/b] (from 0% to 100%): Adjust the energy output for the submarine's systems.
[b]Emergency Cooling Button[/b]: Quickly lower the core temperature in critical moments. Be mindful—uses are limited!
[b]SCRAM Button[/b]: Emergency shutdown of the reactor. Use only in dire situations, as it leaves the submarine without power.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/dbfd06730ecb9e881d2bd83038449481a1be0257.png[/img]

[h3][b]⚙️ Reactor Operating Modes[/b][/h3]
Depending on the power slider setting, the reactor operates in one of three modes:

[list][b]Economic[/b]: Ideal for patrolling and staying hidden. Minimal energy usage, low noise levels.
[b]Standard[/b]: Balanced mode for efficient movement and system use.
[b]Full Power[/b]: Maximum output for emergencies like escaping or attacking. Be cautious of overheating![/list]
[h3][b]🔥 Managing Temperature [/b][/h3]
As you increase reactor power, the core heats up. You'll need to monitor the temperature and respond when it gets too high. Here's how you can manage it:
[list][b]Emergency Cooling[/b]: Use strategically when the temperature reaches "High" or "Critical" levels.
[b]SCRAM[/b]: Deploy this last-resort measure to shut down the reactor instantly. But remember, without power, your submarine is vulnerable![/list]
[h3][b]⚡ Tactical Use of the Reactor [/b][/h3]
Every situation requires a different approach to reactor management:

[list][b]Chase[/b]: Increase power to the max to outrun enemies, risking overheating and loud noise.
[b]Stealth[/b]: Lower power to reduce noise and stay undetected, at the cost of speed.
[b]Patrol[/b]: Maintain a balanced power level to manage energy efficiently and stay ready for any situation.[/list]
[h3][b]🔋 Systems Dependent on the Reactor [/b][/h3]
All critical systems on your submarine draw power from the reactor. Players must manually turn systems on and off based on available power and tactical needs:

[list][b]Ventilation
Radio 
Radar 
Sonar:
Active 
Passive
Anomaly Detector 
Pumps
Torpedoes[/b][/list]
Each system requires a specific amount of power, and some consume extra energy during active use (e.g., sonar pings, torpedo loading).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/adec1afd1a453d0904f5ce1af25d14607fdb9407.png[/img]

[h3][b]💥 Random Failures and Challenges[/b][/h3]
To keep you on your toes, the game features random reactor failures that demand a quick response. A sudden temperature spike? Leaks? In such moments, your skills in managing power, cooling, and the SCRAM button will be crucial.

That's all for today, Captains! We hope this mechanic adds even more excitement and depth to your underwater exploration. As always, we’re eager to hear your feedback and suggestions!

See you in the depths! 🌊🔧
Nuclear Sub Team

notes.title: Missions
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome aboard Commanders! 👋[/b][/h1]

Today we’d like to report more details about the missions you’re going to take during your time on our Nuclear Sub. ☢️

We’ve got a broad scope of operations and targets which are essential for our victory. In general, you could split them into 5 types- recon, escort, tracking, search&destroy, information runs. Currently preparations for the missions are all the same in every case.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/f778ca899744c55ca84ca0abb155ff39adba977c.png[/img]
Complete each task diligently because your reputation is on the line. For each successful mission you’ll receive a reputation reward which is used to upgrade your submarine. 👍

The amount of reputation you’ll receive will depend on the difficulty of the mission as well as the kind of mission you’re taking. Some of them will have additional tasks which you won’t have to take but you’ll miss out on the additional points. Keep in mind it’s not a shame to complete only a primary task and retreat to fight another day. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/99fc107d3f21251f44a066758eaae5cf7b050860.png[/img]
Let’s take a closer look at all the different mission kinds, shall we? 👀

[h3][b]Tracking 🔎[/b][/h3]
Find the ship in a designated area and track its route for a certain time. Watch out to not be discovered!

[h3][b]Passing information 📝[/b][/h3]
Pass the acquired report/information to the higher ups like your general. 

[h3][b]Escort 🛡️[/b][/h3]
Help your allies on their route from point A to B. One of the missions not for those of faint heart because enemy units are likely to show up trying to intercept making your mission much harder. 

[h3][b]Search&Destroy 💥[/b][/h3]
Locate your target and neutralize it as quickly as possible- time is of the essence commander. ⌚

[h3][b]Recon 🔭[/b][/h3]
Sometimes you just happen to be at the right place at the right time. Find the best signal and wait for your crew to decipher the intercepted dialog/message to know what you’re enemies are up to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/e867942aadba7d7ad5aafd6b7859966b32f7a5a0.png[/img]
Some of the missions will be triggers for others so failing is not an option. You have to stay focused and at the top of your game every single moment!

We’d love to hear your opinions on the missions. Please let us know in the comments below or on our discord! 👇 Don’t forget to add our game to your wishlist if you’d like to get notified about the upcoming devlogs and information.

notes.title: How to avoid detection?
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Captains! 👋[/b][/h1]

Today, we’ve decided to give you some more details about sneaking and upgrades! 👍 As we’ve previously mentioned, you can evade enemy ships by stealthy maneuvering around them. With that being said, there are ways for enemies to detect you.

Generally speaking, they can detect you either by hearing you or spotting you with their radars or sight if you happen to emerge too close to the surface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/3426972423a498efc57b16596755b0e28c304f72.png[/img]

[h3]There are some factors you have to keep in mind while you hide:[/h3]

[list][h3]1. 👀 Your enemies also have the same devices you use to detect them, 

2. 👂 While moving, your submarine makes sounds, so moving too close to the enemy ship can also lead to being detected,

3. ↕️ Certain upgrades of your ship can help you hide better, while others make you more likely to be spotted.[/h3][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/ac26a666833ab957b8b69bb2f49d69ac67d7cd1e.png[/img]

[h3]Let’s take a closer look at the upgrades system, shall we?[/h3]
Most of the upgrades are what you could call a double edged sword. They help you raise your ships’ capabilities in one area while making it slightly worse in another. That’s why you need to choose wisely. 🤔

Let’s see how it works in an example. The engine’s updates can go in multiple directions. You can choose to make your submarine faster but at the same time it’ll make the engine create more noise. 🔊 On the other hand, you can decide to sacrifice some of your speed to make the engine work quieter. 🔈

[b]Each maneuver and decision you take has to be wise because coming too close to the enemy or upgrading your devices too much so they create enough noise to make your location known.[/b]

And that's all for today, thank you for reading the entire devlog. If you’d like us to tell you more about any other aspect of the game in particular, please let us know in the comments. You can also do it on our discord! 👇[b] If you enjoyed the devlog and don’t want to miss out on the ones released in the future you can add the game to your wishlist to get notified about every information we publish![/b] 🔥

notes.title: Scouting Enemies
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Commanders! 👋[/b][/h1]

As you know, naval warfare is an art where even the smallest mistakes can spell your doom, while at the same time every small advantage can turn a dire situation into a heaven sent opportunity. 

Today, we’d like to talk about the mechanic which will undoubtedly become vital during your missions. Are you ready to dive into the depths of successful scouting? Let’s find out! 👍

[b]During your gameplay it’ll be of utmost importance to hide yourself from enemy submarines and to dodge them at all costs to finish your missions successfully.[/b]

To make such intricate navigation possible, you’ll have a few tools at your disposal. They’ll help you to learn more about the area you’re currently in and where your enemies are. Some of the tools are sonar, radar and the periscope. 🔭

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/06c373e848201cfee73785909afb997b41d8e404.png[/img]
Be careful though! Although you may not be able to notice, [b]everything you do leaves some kind of sign so using any of those tools may also lead enemies to finding out your location.[/b]

That’s why as we’ve already mentioned in previous devlogs- there are all kinds of upgrades at your disposal. Some of which offer perks such as more area of detection, quieter work and other advantages which will help you during your missions. 🤫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/4af31fcc55ed9b882b1c34d460587f0efbf61c44.png[/img]
Don’t forget about your crew. 👱 Your chance of success is in their hands because they’re the ones who react to your orders. Be it correcting how deep you’re submerged, speed and other parameters which can become vital to dodging your enemies or sneaking past enemies safely.

And as a last resort, when everything else fails, you can also resort to violence and use your tools to pinpoint the location of your enemies and neutralize the threat with torpedoes. 💥

As you can see, there’s a lot to consider during your missions. [b]Keep in mind that the models and their appearance which we’re showing you in the devlogs can still be changed as we’re in an early stage of development.[/b] If you enjoyed today’s devlog please, let us know in the comments which topics you would like to hear about in future materials. 💪 Don’t forget to join our discord community and to add the game to your wishlists on Steam to get notified about every published information about the game!

notes.title: Commanding the Submarine
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Captains! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome aboard. The crew is all on board and awaits your orders. Today we’re here to make sure you’ll know how to do it and every command you pass to your subordinates brings you closer to accomplishing the set goals. 👍

It’s not easy to be responsible for so many people but in our game we made sure it’s as convenient as possible with the use of a [b]circular menu[/b]. As you can see in the screen below, it’s divided into categories to make it more intuitive to use. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/6c2f165eca74ab9420ca53f447b16458cd37eb2c.png[/img]
At this point you might have wondered what orders I can give to the crew. 🤔 There are all kinds of them and while some are simple like [b]changing the course of the submarine, its speed or requesting information from radar or sonar[/b], some require serious consideration. We’re talking about [b]loading torpedoes, firing them in specific patterns[/b] and more. Are you ready to take those tough calls when the time comes? 

That brings us to another important factor- [b]the crew[/b]. Although you can give the same order on multiple occasions the time needed to perform the action may warry. That’s because the game takes into consideration the human aspect. 👱 Things like [b]the rank of the officer[/b] responsible for that particular section of the submarine or your[b] crew’s morale[/b] will play [b]an important part[/b] throughout your gameplay. [b]The better officer and morale you have, the quicker your crew will work.[/b]

[b]On the other hand, once hunger, lack of sleep and low morale start appearing your crewmates may refuse to execute your orders. 😡 That’s why taking good care of all your people is very important. Make sure their needs are satisfied or else you’ll put the entire operation at risk. ⚠️[/b]

There is a lot to consider in that regard so let’s end today’s devlog here. We’re happy to have you with us today and as always, we’d like to invite you to [b]join our discord community[/b] 👇 and to [b]add our game to your wishlists on Steam[/b]. This will help you stay notified about all the important information!

notes.title: Submarine pt.2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to our submarine hangar. After the previous devlog, you’ve been asking a lot of questions about the submarine unit which will be available in the game. That’s why today we’d like to shed some more light on this topic! 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/45984cdfc7359a01a0a8f9d35054c81adc2143c3.png[/img]
[h3]As we’ve already mentioned, the model ship which is our template is USS Nautilus (SSN-571) - the first submarine in history which was powered by nuclear energy! ☢️[/h3]

We’re doing our best to maintain the realism while designing the interior. Did you know that because of this innovative power source this submarine could’ve stayed in the field for a few months? 🤯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/a419132a9b7166caa96b6043187bddb2cfa4cb41.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/3c5055b8b39e1339f3d4006963e5648f8fbc7a76.png[/img]
It’s worth mentioning that the interior looks of the sub will not be altered during your playthroughs but you’ll still be able to enhance its capabilities using various upgrades! 🔧

Thus far all you could’ve seen is a lot of metal and plastic but you can’t stay in such an environment all the time. That’s why the cabins are more cozy, with wood adding some warm color to the overall gray scenery. 🖌️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/771a6fa21cda7a175f5da651ee78ffe1a2fc9f31.png[/img]
[h3]You’ll spend a lot of time here. This is the place where you’ll manage your unit, give orders to the crew, prepare for the missions and more! Speaking of crewmates, when you look around the ship you’ll get to see them working at their respective spots! 🤩 [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/78bede8a9e23c15a5888ed26663460278e971b55.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/066666bed9a7d77b2469af54a78c3bb358d329a5.png[/img]
How fortunate you are to have such a diligent crew working under your command! We’re also doing our best and as always, we’d love to hear your opinions on the game. 🙂 That’s why [b]if you have any questions, suggestions or ideas please, don’t hesitate to get in touch with us here, in the discussion section or on our discord![/b] We’ll gladly have a conversation with all of you! ❤️‍ If you’d like to help the game grow and don’t want to miss out on any important information, please [b]consider adding this game to your wishlists on Steam![/b]

notes.title: Submarine
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Commanders! 👋[/b][/h1]

[b]We’re honored to welcome you aboard our Nuclear Sub. Today- in the first of many devlogs we’d like to show you some basic concepts for our game, as well as share the progress we’ve made thus far! 📝 Without further ado, let’s get started! 🤩[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/c2e2efa92eab20edd7ed8154debfb1a8e3f00a1f.png[/img]
If you’re fans of the submarine technology you may find this magnificent watercraft eerily similar. That’s right! [b]The unit you’ll get to command, although changed here and there, is a replica of the historical USS-Nautilus[/b]! 💪 

[h3]It was the first nuclear submarine to beat all the submerge depth records as well as the first one to pass underneath the North Pole. 🤯[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/7c6695abd0e1a2da881a7142987f76f353a653e3.png[/img]
Before we walk deeper into the ship, we’d like to share an exciting feature with you. [b]The terrain available in our game is based on the bathymetric maps of the Earth’s northern hemisphere[/b], so we can get actual data about the coast lines, layout of the seabed and more! 🔥 

[h3]Keep in mind that the data is overwhelmingly vast so the terrains will be scaled but we’re aiming to give you a taste of the real terrain struggles.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/6e430e82200aa7ff05e67cb8d5d76e71db45fd5e.png[/img]
During your gameplay, you’ll become a captain and using various available data you’re to give orders to your subordinates. The game will be a FPP experience and you’ll be able to use many tools. 🧰 The on-board systems are still under development but right now we can already promise that you’ll get to use periscope, sonar, radar, reactor with an extra diesel switch, ventilation system, fathometer and more! 🤩 Each of the tools and systems will be explained in more detail in the future devlogs. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/c162811ac73d0acd2986652e015d28dbc75e1671.png[/img]
[h3][b]All of the tools and systems are based on the actual technology used at that time but we can’t stress enough that this is a computer game and even more than a real experience, it is supposed to give you lots of fun and that’s why we’re modifying the use of those elements so they can fit the gameplay much better. 👍[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/402fa9f0e5cc4d516b820185b477332b2975c176.png[/img]
The command system is still in a fairly early stage of development so you’ll have to look forward to the future devlogs if you’re interested in this aspect of the game but as you could see on the first screen in the devlog, [b]your own submarine port hangar is already built and it is safe to say, this place is bound to become an important part of your gameplay[/b]. There, you can [b]upgrade the ship, manage your crew and pick up various missions[/b], which we’ll briefly discuss right now. ⚓

We can’t end the devlog without mentioning the missions especially because [b]we aim to inspire some of them with different tasks the Silent Service performed during the Cold War[/b]. Other missions include reconnaissance, covert missions, reconnoitering or even some torpedo action, although the last category will not really follow any particular historical events.

That’s it for today! We can’t wait to hear if you like the overall idea for the game so let us know in the comments! [b]We’d like to invite you to join us on our discord and to add our game to your wishlists on Steam[/b] to make sure you won’t miss out on any future devlog! 

[url=https://discord.gg/bSxHdR7yzh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43460543/538bcac86a0ce3fc2a5a94e869ef452a1f35cad0.png[/img][/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2233390/Nuclear_Sub/

See you soon,
Nuclear Sub team
